The modifications in `src/li-pkg-builder.c` are related in that they collectively address an issue with how package filenames are processed. By introducing `root_prefix`, the code becomes more flexible and corrects the previous logic that relied on a hardcoded prefix (`LI_SW_ROOT_PREFIX`). This change ensures that the filename handling is consistent and adaptable to different root directory configurations, thereby fixing the archive layout issue that was introduced in a prior commit.
